discovery.source: static analysis of the signed APK (dex string constants / Retrofit annotations)
discovery.note: Paths are confirmed present in the client. HTTP methods and request/response bodies are best-inferred and must be confirmed by one dynamic capture (see docs/FINDINGS.md). Full harvested list: docs/discovered-endpoints.txt (183 paths).

attestation.note: Play Integrity refs belong to the Nok Nok FIDO/UAF SDK (com.noknok / com.fido.uaf), used only in the optional biometric login path. No Firebase App Check, no X-Integrity/X-AppCheck header on the API. Confirm 'required=false' with one live login + one control call.

identity_headers._note: parental-control ops are id_token-authed (Authorization: <id_token>) plus these headers; NOT SigV4.

accessibility_pin.summary: Accessibility-protection PIN lock for the child device: retrieve, SMS-send, and validate the guard PIN, plus the age-capture notification flag and device-shadow tamper state.

retrievePin.description: Retrieve the accessibility protection PIN; newPin=true asks the backend to generate a fresh one.

sendPin.description: Send the accessibility PIN to the device/guardian via an SMS push notification.

validatePin.description: Validate a submitted PIN against the accessibility protection lock (returns whether it matches).

getAgeCaptureNotification.description: Read the age-capture notification setting/flag for the accessibility-protection feature.

postAgeCaptureNotification.description: Create/send an age-capture notification (POST with body) for the accessibility-protection feature.

putAgeCaptureNotification.description: Update the age-capture notification flag (PUT, no body — toggles/acknowledges it).

getDeviceShadowDetails.description: Read the device 'shadow' details — tamper/accessibility-protection state reported for the child device.

account.summary: The Verizon Family account itself: read and edit member profiles (name, avatar, DOB attestation), enrolled devices, and the subscription plan, including deleting profiles/devices or leaving the service.

addDevice.description: Add/register a device under a user profile (POST with device body).

addOnboardingDevice.description: Register a device during initial onboarding (POST with body).

attestDob.description: Attest (self-declare) a profile's date of birth (PATCH age/attestation).

choosePlan.description: Subscribe the account to the given {planType} plan (POST, no body).

deleteDevice.description: Permanently remove a device from a profile — deletes its enrollment (irreversible).

deleteMyself.description: Remove the current user's own SafePath service enrollment — leaves the family service (irreversible).

deleteProfile.description: Permanently delete a user profile from the account (irreversible).

updateDeviceName.description: Rename a device (PATCH devices with the new name).

updateFamilyNameOrTimeZone.description: Update the family/account display name or time zone (PATCH accounts).

updatePlan.description: Change the account's subscription to {planType} (PUT, no body).

updateProfile.description: Update general user-profile fields (PATCH userprofiles with body).

updateProfileImage.description: Set or replace a profile's avatar image (PUT images with body).

updateProfileName.description: Rename a user profile (PATCH accounts/userprofiles with body).

activity_tracking.summary: The child device's activity timeline from the SafePath comms feed — pull activity events overall or scoped to a single day.

getDailyActivities.description: List a device's activity for a day from the same feed (timezone required, day-scoped view).

age_verification.summary: Adult/age identity verification via the Mitek ID-scan SDK — fetch its license and public keys and submit ID/DOB data to verify a profile's age.

getPublicKey.description: Fetch the Mitek public key used to encrypt ID-document data before age/identity verification.

getSdkLicenseKey.description: Fetch the license key for the on-device ID-scan (Mitek) SDK.

submitVerification.description: Submit age/identity verification — POST ID/DOB data to userprofiles/age/verify.

app_block.summary: App blocking on the child device — block apps via content-filter subcategories, read the device's blocked-apps list, and report accessibility and per-app enforcement status.

blockApp.description: Block (or change the block state of) an app by posting a content-filter subcategory entry. Verified live (2026-08-26 eCapture): the request body byte-matches this shape (enabled=true blocks, false unblocks) and the CLI --dry-run reproduces the app's request exactly.

getBlockedApps.description: Fetch the blocked-apps sync list for a device (deviceId in path; ETag-cached).

sendAccessibilityStatus.description: Report the child device's accessibility-service status (needed to enforce blocking).

sendBlockStatus.description: Report per-app block-enforcement results for Android apps in a batch (offline token).

app_management.summary: Managed-app control and usage on the child device — read and update app install/enable status, pull per-app usage stats, and fetch Gizmo AI interaction logs.

getInteractionData.description: Fetch Gizmo AI assistant interaction logs (paged by logId/limit/direction).

getAppUsages.description: Read per-app usage stats for the device from the comms usage feed.

updateAppStatus.description: Update managed-app status — request install/uninstall/enable changes (POST with body).

getAppStatus.description: Read managed-app status (install/enable state) for the device.

calendar_sync.summary: School-calendar sync (geocal): find a child's school by ZIP, select its calendar, pull school-day/holiday events, and manage sync preferences.

calls_and_texts.summary: Call and text monitoring: trust/block/watch contact lists, address-book name mappings, restriction schedules, and per-contact activity logs and summaries.

getTopContactListByActivityV7.description: Top contacts by call/text activity (v7). Fixed (baked): activityType=call,text, timezone=preferred. Query: profileId, deviceId (member's ids), startDate/endDate=yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS'Z', betaProviders=RCS|RCS,GIZMO (optional).

config.summary: App configuration delivery: secure and non-secure remote config, service/API keys, and static CDN JSON for the config file and map styles.

contacts.summary: Manage child/Gizmo device contacts: add, update, and bulk-delete calling contacts and buddies, handle invites and permissions, and validate numbers.

gizmoDevicesCheckEligibility.description: Check whether the profile is eligible to add Gizmo devices.

gizmoDevicesGetLists.description: List Gizmo devices available to the profile.

gizmoImportDevices.description: List importable Gizmo devices for a signed-in user.

gizmoImportDevicesNotSignedInUser.description: List importable Gizmo devices (not-signed-in v1 variant).

gizmoImportEligibility.description: Check eligibility to import Gizmo devices.

gizmoImportEligibilityNotSignedInUser.description: Check Gizmo import eligibility (not-signed-in v1 variant).

gizmoImportInitiate.description: Start importing Gizmo devices into the account.

gizmoImportInitiateNotSignedInUser.description: Start a Gizmo import (not-signed-in v1 variant).

linkGizmoAccount.description: Link/authenticate a Gizmo account via token exchange.

unlinkGizmoAccount.description: Unlink a Gizmo account from the profile, permanently removing the link.

validateGizmoMdn.description: Validate a Gizmo MDN before pairing.

getDeviceStatus2.description: Get device status via the alternate v5 vsf device-status endpoint.

getDeviceLogDownloadUrl.description: Get a download URL for a device's uploaded log file.

getDeviceLogs.description: List a device's available log files.

getDeviceSettings.description: Read a device's settings for a given settingsType.

triggerLogUpload.description: Ask a device to upload its logs to the cloud.

pause_internet.summary: Pause or resume a child profile's internet access: list devices with their current pause state and toggle a pause on or off.

getDevices.description: List devices and their current internet-pause state (v6).

pauseInternet.description: Pause internet access for a profile's device(s).

unPauseInternet.description: Resume (un-pause) internet access for the device(s).

pet_tracker.summary: Pet collar tracker: start/end/escalate live-location sessions, read activity/rest/step data, manage the collar's WiFi networks and firmware, and fetch breeds, keys, tokens, and the purchase link.

endRttOrLpm.description: End a real-time-tracking (RTT) or lost-pet-mode (LPM) session.

escalateRttToLpm.description: Escalate a real-time-tracking session to lost-pet mode.

getAllAvailableEmergencyContacts.description: List the profile's available emergency contacts.

getPetLiveTrackerSessionInfo.description: Get info on the current live-tracking session.

getPetTrackerLocationHistory.description: Get location history for a live-tracking session by session-id.

getPetTrackerSMSLink.description: Get a shareable SMS link for a live-tracking session by session-id.

deleteWifiDetails.description: Remove a saved WiFi network from the pet collar (DELETE with body).

getActivity.description: Get the pet's activity data over a given duration.

getActivityV2.description: Get the pet's activity data over a duration (v2 response model).

getBreeds.description: List pet breeds, optionally filtered by species.

getCollarSoftwareInfo.description: Get the collar's device/software status info.

getReportingToken.description: Get a mobile-SDK reporting token (POST, no body).

getRest.description: Get the pet's rest/sleep data over a given duration.

getSdkToken.description: Get an SDK OAuth token (POST, no body).

getStepDistribution.description: Get step-count distribution benchmarked by breed/age.

getWifiList.description: List the WiFi networks saved on the collar.

saveWifiDetails.description: Save a new WiFi network to the collar.

updateWifiDetails.description: Update a saved WiFi network on the collar.

professional_monitoring.summary: Professional (agent-assisted) safety monitoring enrollment: create/update/activate/deactivate subscribers, file a help/SOS request, and manage the monitored address and subscriber name.

createHelp.description: File a help/SOS request to the professional-monitoring service.

createSubscribers.description: Enroll a subscriber into professional monitoring.

deactivateProfile.description: Deactivate a subscriber's professional-monitoring profile by subscriber-id.

getRemoteProfessionalMonitoringAddress.description: Get the monitoring address on file for a profile.

reactivateProfile.description: Reactivate a previously deactivated subscriber's monitoring profile by subscriber-id.

updateAddress.description: Update a saved monitoring address by address-id.

updateFirstAndLastName.description: Update the subscriber's first and last name.

updateSubscribers.description: Update a subscriber's professional-monitoring enrollment details.

validateAddress.description: Validate a monitoring address before enrollment.

profile.summary: A family member's profile: fetch selectable avatars, view the member's most-used apps, and resend a pending invite.

getTopApps.description: Get a profile's most-used apps (top N by usage count).

getProfileAvatars.description: List the selectable profile-avatar images at the requested resolution.

pubnub.summary: PubNub realtime-messaging plumbing: fetch the profile's PubNub channel configuration, mint subscribe tokens, and register the device's push-notification token.

getPubNubConfig.description: GET the profile's PubNub realtime-messaging configuration (channels/keys) used to receive live updates.

getPubNubToken.description: POST to mint a PubNub access token authorizing subscription to the account's realtime channels.

putDeviceToken.description: PUT to register or update this device's push-notification token on the profile.

real_time_tracking.summary: Real-time location tracking (RTT) sessions: start or refresh a live-tracking session for a device and read back its location-event history.

getHistoryEvents.description: GET the current RTT session, optionally including its accumulated live location events (includeLocEvents).

invoke.description: POST to start or refresh a real-time location-tracking (RTT) session for the target device.

restricted_usage.summary: Call/text usage limits: create or update a limit, list all configured limits, and reset an existing limit for a child's line.

addLimit.description: PUT to create or update a call/text usage limit for the target profile's line.

getAllTheLimits.description: List all configured call/text usage limits. limitType=all is fixed (baked). Query: profileId, deviceId (the member's ids).

resetLimit.description: DELETE (with body) to reset/clear a configured call/text usage limit identified in the payload.

reviews.summary: In-app Gizmo review prompts: check whether the user should be shown a review prompt, submit their review, and update the prompt's action state.

getReviewEligibility.description: GET whether the user is currently eligible to be shown a Gizmo review prompt.

submitReview.description: POST the user's Gizmo review/rating content.

updateReviewAction.description: PATCH the review-prompt state to record an action such as dismissed, deferred, or completed.

roadside_assistance.summary: Roadside Assistance (RSA): manage saved vehicles, look up car makes/models, submit/cancel/track rescue requests, find and validate tow destinations, and control member access.

addVehicle.description: POST to add a vehicle to the roadside-assistance profile.

cancelRequest.description: PUT to cancel an in-progress roadside rescue request.

deleteExistVehicle.description: DELETE a saved vehicle by {vehicle-id}, removing it from the RSA profile.

dismissRsaNotificationBanner.description: PATCH the rescue setup state to dismiss the RSA notification banner.

dismissWhatsNew.description: PATCH (v6) to dismiss the RSA 'What's New' callout for the user.

getCarMakes.description: GET the list of vehicle makes available for a given model {year}.

getCarModels.description: POST make/year criteria to list matching vehicle models.

getRescueHistory.description: GET the history of past roadside rescue requests.

getRescueInfo.description: GET details of the current/active roadside rescue request.

getRsaMemberAccess.description: GET which family members/dependents have roadside-assistance access.

getTowLocations.description: POST location criteria to find nearby tow/service destinations for a rescue.

setUpRsaIntroBottomSheet.description: POST to mark the RSA intro bottom-sheet as shown/set up for the user.

submitRescue.description: POST to submit a new roadside rescue request.

updateExistingUserVehicleDetails.description: PUT to update details of an existing saved vehicle by {vehicle-id}.

updateRsaMemberAccess.description: PATCH to grant or revoke roadside-assistance access for family members/dependents.

validateTowLocation.description: POST a chosen tow destination to validate it before submitting the rescue.

safety_alerts.summary: Safety alerts feed (wm-sos): retrieve the active safety/SOS alerts surfaced for the family.

getSafetyAlerts.description: GET the list of active safety/SOS alerts for the family from the wm-sos service.

schedule_alert.summary: Scheduled location alerts: recurring "notify me when they arrive at / leave a place at a set time" rules you can create, list, update, and delete.

deleteScheduledAlert.description: DELETE /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — permanently removes a scheduled location-alert rule (rule sent in body)

getScheduledAlerts.description: GET /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — list scheduled location alerts, filterable by eventType/profileRole/profileId

postScheduleAlert.description: POST /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — create a new scheduled location-alert rule

updateScheduledAlert.description: PUT /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — modify an existing scheduled location-alert rule

schedules.summary: Time-management controls: bedtime/school/downtime schedules, per-app time limits, daily screen-time limits, and the child's ask-for-more-time request/approval flow.

putAppUsageStats.description: POST /frisco/parental-control/v5/web-app-activity — child device reports its web/app usage stats

updateSchedulerRunStatus.description: POST /vsf/tamper/v5/screenTimeScheduler — child device reports the screen-time scheduler's run status

getScreenTime.description: Get child app-usage / screen-time (v1 app-usage). Query: profile-id (child profileId), product-id, device-id (child deviceId), requested-date=yyyy-MM-dd.

acceptDeclineAskTimeRequest.description: PUT /parental-control/frisco/v7/app-limits — parent approves or declines a child's request for more app time

getAppTimeLimits.description: GET /parental-control/frisco/v7/app-limits — list configured per-app time limits

getAskTimeRequests.description: GET /parental-control/frisco/v8/app-limits/askTime — list the child's pending ask-for-more-time requests

postAppTimeLimit.description: POST /parental-control/frisco/v7/app-limits/askTime — submit an ask-for-more-time request against an app limit

postSchedule.description: POST /parental-control/frisco/v6/schedules — create a new bedtime/school/downtime schedule. Body schema shares the schedules[] shape captured live for putSchedule (create omits scheduleId); confirmed=false since only the update (PUT) flow was exercised on the device.

putSchedule.description: PUT /parental-control/frisco/v6/schedules — update an existing bedtime/school/downtime schedule. Verified live (2026-08-26 eCapture): the request body wraps a schedules[] array of {scheduleId,scheduleType,name,days[],startTime,endTime,timezone,alertOn,blockContent}; alertOn/blockContent select the mode (both false = Off, alertOn=true = alert-only, blockContent=true = block). The earlier {id} stub was incomplete.

deleteSchedule.description: DELETE /parental-control/frisco/v6/schedules — permanently removes a bedtime/school/downtime schedule (by schedule-id)

getScreenTimeData.description: GET /parental-control/frisco/v7/screen-time-limits — get configured daily screen-time limits

actionOnScreenTimeData.description: PUT /parental-control/frisco/v7/screen-time-limits — act on a screen-time request (approve/deny extra time; requestId query)

deleteScreenTimeData.description: DELETE /parental-control/frisco/v7/screen-time-limits — permanently removes a screen-time limit (by screenTimeLimitId)

askForMoreScreenTime.description: POST /parental-control/frisco/v7/screen-time-limits/askTime — child requests additional screen time

getCategories.description: List web/app activity grouped by content category (v6). categorySupported=v6 and r=0 are fixed (baked into the path). Query: timezone=IANA tz id, date=yyyy-MM-dd, usageType=profile|device (default profile), resolution=1x|2x|3x (use 1x), sz=icon size (e.g. 36x).

getInsights.description: GET /frisco/parental-control/v6/web-app-activity/insights — retrieve web/app usage insights and analytics

createAppLimit.description: POST /parental-control/frisco/v7/app-limits — create a per-app daily time limit

updateAppLimit.description: PUT /parental-control/frisco/v7/app-limits — update an existing per-app time limit (by appLimitsId)

deleteAppLimit.description: DELETE /parental-control/frisco/v7/app-limits — permanently removes an app time limit (by appLimitsId)

postScheduleAlert.description: POST /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — create a new scheduled location alert

updateScheduledAlert.description: PUT /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — modify an existing scheduled location alert

deleteScheduledAlert.description: DELETE /vsf/location/v5/scheduled/alert/settings — permanently removes a scheduled location alert (rule sent in body)

security_threat.summary: Security-threat protection: list the malware/phishing threats detected and blocked on the child's device.

getThreats.description: List detected security threats (v5). Query: eventId (the security-threat event id being queried), page (default 1), per-page (default 100). serviceId travels as the x-fp-identifier-target-serviceid header.

services_hub.summary: Services Hub catalog: discover which add-on services a line is eligible for, check each service tile's setup status, and fetch tile artwork.

getEligibleServices.description: GET /servicecatalog/fam/servicescatalog/v6/eligibleservices — list add-on services the account/line is eligible for

getSetupStatus.description: GET /servicecatalog/fam/servicescatalog/v5/setupstatus — get onboarding/setup status for service tiles (optional tile-id)

setup_wizard.summary: Onboarding setup-wizard tasks: read a profile's list of setup/onboarding tasks and update their status as they're completed.

getUserTasks.description: GET /account/fam/task-management/v5/userprofiles/tasks — list a user profile's setup/onboarding tasks

updateUserTask.description: PATCH /account/fam/task-management/v5/userprofiles/tasks — update a setup task's status (e.g. mark complete)

sos.summary: WatchMe SOS / SafeWalk: timed safety check-in sessions with location sharing — start, extend, escalate, or mark-safe a session, manage the safety PIN and profile, and review session history and insights.

manageWmsPin.description: PATCH /fam/wm-sos/v5/profiles — set or update the WatchMe/SafeWalk safety PIN

postWmsOnboardProfile.description: POST /fam/wm-sos/v5/profiles — onboard/enroll a profile into WatchMe SOS (SafeWalk)

escalateToSoSRequest.description: PATCH /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions — escalate an active WatchMe check-in session to a full SOS emergency

extendSoSSession.description: PATCH /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions/extend — extend the duration of an active WatchMe/SOS session

getWatchMeSoSSessionInfo.description: GET /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions — get status/info of current WatchMe SOS session(s)

markSafeWatchMeSoSRequest.description: PATCH /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions — mark yourself safe, resolving/ending the WatchMe session

submitWatchMeRequest.description: POST /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions — start a new WatchMe timed safety check-in session

watchMeSosAlerts.description: GET /safety/fam/wm-sos/v6/sessions/insights/summary — get a summary of WatchMe SOS session insights

watchMeSosInsightSummaryList.description: GET /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions/insights/list — list WatchMe SOS session insight summaries

getWatchMeSoSHistory.description: GET /fam/wm-sos/v5/sessions/{session-id}/location/history — retrieve the location breadcrumb history for a session

step_counter.summary: Kid-device step counter (pedometer): read step-count history charted by schedule period and set the daily step goal.

getChartStepsTracking.description: Read the device's step-count history for a schedule period, formatted for the step-tracker chart.

setStepGoals.description: Set the device's daily step goal (written through the device-settings endpoint).

subscription.summary: Manage the account's paid plan subscription -- currently only canceling it.

cancelSubscription.description: Cancel the account's paid subscription, ending the plan (irreversibly removes the subscription).

tamper.summary: Anti-tamper reporting: the child device posts the health of each protection (accessibility service, device admin, battery/power saving, VPN, notifications, call-only mode, screen-time) and the parent sets tamper-recovery instructions.

postAccessibilityStatus.description: Report whether the Android accessibility service (needed to block apps) is enabled/disabled on the child device.

postAdminStatus.description: Report the device-admin privilege status (granted or revoked) on the child device.

postBannerStatus.description: Report the state of the on-device tamper-warning banner.

postCallOnlyModeStatus.description: Report the call-only-mode tamper status on the child device.

postHibernationStatus.description: Report whether the OS has hibernated (auto-suspended) the app on the child device.

postParentalControlsRemoved.description: Signal that parental controls were removed/disabled on the child device (no body).

postScreenTimeCallOnlyModeStatus.description: Report the screen-time call-only-mode status on the child device.

putTamperInstructions.description: Update the parent-facing tamper remediation instructions for the device.

postBatteryUsage.description: Report whether battery optimization is exempting/throttling the app on the child device.

postBluetoothScan.description: Report the Bluetooth-scan permission status on the child device.

postNotificationStatus.description: Report the app's notification-permission status on the child device.

postPhysicalActivityStatus.description: Report the physical-activity (motion) permission status on the child device.

postPowerSaving.description: Report whether power-saving mode is active on the child device.

updateScreenTimeTamperStatus.description: Report the screen-time enforcement tamper status on the child device.

updateVpnTamperStatus.description: Report the VPN status (the VPN carries web filtering) on the child device.

todo.summary: Kid's chore/task to-do list: create, list, update, and delete to-do items.

createTodo.description: Create a new to-do/task item on the child's list.

deleteTodo.description: Permanently delete the to-do item identified by todoId.

invoke (getTodos).description: List the child's to-do items (method name is literally 'invoke').

updateTodo.description: Update an existing to-do item (mark done, edit text, reschedule, etc.).

user_setting.summary: Update the signed-in user's account/auth-level settings via the IAM device-auth service.

updateUserSettings.description: Update the signed-in user's account/auth settings (raw key-value map body).

video_calling.summary: WebRTC video calling between family members: place a call, answer an incoming call, and manage an active call.

callManage.description: Manage an active WebRTC video call (signaling/control such as hang-up or state change).

initCall.description: Start (place) a WebRTC video call to a family member (empty POST).

initCallAnswer.description: Answer an incoming WebRTC video call.

vpn_status.summary: Reports whether the on-device VPN that powers web/app activity monitoring is up and visible on a child's device.

getWebAppVisibility.description: Check whether the monitoring VPN is active so web/app activity is visible; takes a vpn-retry-type query

wearable.summary: Pair, onboard and authenticate a child's wearable watch (e.g. Gizmo) and relay location alerts from it to a guardian.

confirmWatchPairing.description: Verify and confirm a watch pairing via the wearable-auth service (POST watch/auth/verify)

notifyGuardianFromDependantWatch.description: Send a location alert/notification from the child's watch to the guardian

onboardWearableWatch.description: Create the child user profile to onboard a new wearable watch onto the account

resendInvite.description: Resend the family-service invite for the watch profile (PATCH invites)

watchAuth.description: Acquire the watch device's auth/access token (bootstrap token acquisition, no service-id header)

web_and_apps.summary: Read-only reporting of a child's web and app activity: visited websites, app usage, category breakdowns and screen-time insights.

getAppUsageDetails.description: List per-app usage detail from web/app activity (v7). usageType=profile and categorySupported=v6 are fixed (baked into the path). Query: timezone=IANA tz id, date=yyyy-MM-dd, app-name (the app being drilled into), subcategory-id (its content subcategory id).

getCategories.description: List web/app activity grouped by content category (v6). categorySupported=v6 and r=0 are fixed (baked into the path). Query: timezone=IANA tz id, date=yyyy-MM-dd, usageType=profile|device (default profile), resolution=1x|2x|3x (use 1x), sz=icon size (e.g. 36x).

getInsights.description: Get screen-time insights for web/app activity by usageType, timezone and category support (v6)

getWebsite.description: List visited websites from web/app activity (v6). categorySupported=v6 and r=0 are fixed (baked into the path). Query: date=yyyy-MM-dd, timezone=IANA tz id, usageType=profile|device (default profile), page (default 1), per-page (default 100), resolution=1x|2x|3x (use 1x), sz=icon size (e.g. 36x). scheduleStartTime/scheduleEndTime (HH:mm) are optional — sent only for the scheduled-view variant.

getWebsiteDetails.description: Get activity detail for a single visited website (v6). categorySupported=v6 is fixed (baked into the path). Query: date=yyyy-MM-dd, app-id + name identify the website (from a getWebsites row), usageType=profile|device (optional, default profile), location-name (optional place name).

getWebsites.description: List visited websites from web/app activity (v5). Query: date=yyyy-MM-dd (day), timezone=IANA tz id (e.g. America/Los_Angeles), page (1-based, default 1), per-page (default 100).

getWebsites2.description: List visited websites via the v5 /website endpoint

website.summary: Manage a child's website allow/block list and toggle enforced safe search.

deleteWebsite.description: Remove a website entry from the allow/block list, keyed by profileDomainId

disableSafeSearch.description: Turn off enforced safe search for the child's browsing (DELETE safesearch)

enableSafeSearch.description: Turn on enforced safe search for the child's browsing (POST safesearch, no body)

postWebsite.description: Add a single website to the allow/block list

postWebsites.description: Batch-add multiple websites to the allow/block list in one call

whats_new.summary: Fetch the app's What's New release-notes/announcements feed for the account.

getWhatsNew.description: Fetch the What's New release notes/announcements list (v1 releases endpoint)
